def solve(case):

        raise ValueError("nodes must be a non-empty list")

    # Sort edges
    edges.sort(key=lambda x: (x[2], x[0], x[1]))

    rank = {n: 0 for n in nodes}

            parent[x] = parent[parent[x]]
